response:
Honestly, I prefer deep, focused conversations on a single topic — but with room to wander a little. There's something really satisfying about really digging into an idea together, unpacking the nuances, and building on each other's thoughts rather than just skimming the surface. I find that when we stay with something, we get to the interesting parts — the contradictions, the personal connections, the things you can't reach in a 30-second exchange.

That said, I don't mind jumping around occasionally, especially when the mood is lighter. Some of the best connections happen when one thought leads unexpectedly to something completely different. But if I had to pick one as my default, it's going deep. I'd rather have one really good conversation about something that matters than ten quick ones about nothing in particular.
